upstream_pin.version_boundary: EF Core 10.0.12 relational model planning only; EF Core 9, EF Core 11 preview, provider-specific conventions and later 10.x patches are excluded

constructs.invariant: Fluent ToTable may override a Table attribute; the attribute alone is not the physical table oracle.
HasKey over two properties must preserve physical key order; no single-id projection is allowed.
HasForeignKey with a string may create an EF shadow property absent from the CLR type.
Environment-dependent ToTable schema cannot be assigned one static physical schema without runtime binding.

runtime_oracle_plan.toolchain: Pin an exact .NET 10 SDK, NuGet package/content hashes, EF Core 10.0.12 and an approved relational provider on a T20-isolated runner
steps: Verify v10.0.12 Git tag/commit, six upstream source hashes and exact NuGet package versions and checksums before restore.
Materialize each authored fixture as a separate C# project with provider and DbContextOptions; restore with a locked dependency graph, build and retain compiler diagnostics and SDK identity.

Read DbContext.Model metadata for each case: table/schema, StoreObjectIdentifier column names, ordered FindPrimaryKey properties, foreign/principal key pairs and IsShadowProperty flags; compare with source expectations.
Bind two TENANT_SCHEMA values separately and test annotation-versus-Fluent precedence, composite key ordering and shadow FK behavior; never infer a fixed schema from source alone.
For physical migration/schema comparison use an approved provider and disposable database that supports schemas; SQLite alone cannot verify schema-qualified tables.
Require CR-T10-002/T08 C# semantic facts, T16 independent read and T19 mutation review before any T10 provider or support claim.
Check T01 projection, packed-artifact consumption and certification only after upstream facts and T00 composition approval; preserve blocked catalog state until then.

limits: The C# files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not upstream source copies, compiled models or executed EF Core runtime evidence.
The .NET SDK, NuGet restore/lock, relational provider, model metadata and physical database comparisons are not executed in this scope.
The catalog remains blocked-upstream-facts; accepted source-facts admission is not certification or generation handoff.
No T08 C# persistence facts, T10 parser/provider, shared-contract projection, registry entry or packed-artifact path is added.
No independent attestation, target certification or release gate is exercised here.
